t: A western Georgian kingdom ruled from Kutaisi by a branch of the Bagrationi dynasty, separate from 1260 and definitively from 1490.
It spent over two centuries as an Ottoman tributary, troubled by rebellious vassals and a cruel trade in slaves.
Solomon I revived it in the eighteenth century, but the Russian Empire deposed Solomon II and annexed it in 1810.
dyk: Two battles fought at Chikhori shaped Imereti’s history: Bagrat’s victory over George VIII in 1463 and Solomon I’s victory over the Ottomans in 1757.
ev: David VI Narin withdraws to Kutaisi and founds a western kingdom
